header.description: What: SHOWCASE 'Crossfire' (docs/SHOWCASE_Scenarios.md §2) - team domination, bots on both sides (players join on the Deploy screen). Blue (2 squads x 4) from the south base (650,275) to points A and B, Red from the north (650,525) to C and B (each squad SquadDefend at its point). Three capture points A (400,400), B (525,400), C (650,400): a side captures with more men inside for 10 s (HoldArea capture, captureSeconds). Tickets: 150 each (Counter), -1 per own man down, -1 per 10 s for each point the enemy holds (whileTrue drain triggers; doubled from 12:00, sudden death). 'Blue lead' = Blue minus Red; 40 behind => that side's bots +1 tier (never twice within 2 min). Supply crates at 3, 6, 9, 12 min, each at one of 4 spots (variant). A team with fewer than 8 men up gets a bot every 15 s at its base (game/bot). End: tickets 0, domination (all three points 60 s) or 15 min. Judge: (1) a point's Owner flips only after 10 s of a majority; (2) while a point is held the other side's tickets fall ~1 per 10 s; (3) four crate drops, 3 min apart, each at one of the 4 spots; (4) the comeback raises only the losing side, at most once per 2 min; (5) bots respawn at their base. Generated by scripts/gen-showcase-crossfire.py.
